case_name: Vasupalli Guru Murthy v. The State of Andhra Pradesh, Rep. by its Principal Secretary, Department of Home, Secretariat, Velagapudi, Amaravathi, Guntur District and others

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Vasupalli Guru Murthy, s/o Raju, aged 28 years, Resident of House No.9-43-10A, Appala Swamy Street, Mahantipuram, Vijayawada-520 001.
parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Andhra Pradesh, Rep. by its Principal Secretary, Department of Home, Secretariat, Velagapudi, Amaravathi, Guntur District and others

facts_of_case: Petitioner was married to Sai Divya, who is the daughter of respondent Nos.6 and 7. Petitioner's minor daughter, Vasupalli Manjula Satya Sri (aged 4 years), was kidnapped by respondent Nos.5 and 6 while petitioner was in police custody.

legal_principles.principle: A natural guardian has the right to custody of a minor child under Section 6 of the Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act, 1956.
legal_principles.held: Under Section 6 of the Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act, 1956, he is the natural guardian of Satya Sri as she is four years of age.
applicable_acts_sections: Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act — Section 6

legal_principles.principle: A court may consider the mental and physical harassment faced by a spouse as a factor in determining the best interests of the child.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner used to harass Sai Divya physically and mentally suspecting her character and despite trying to settle the issues amicably, the petitioner did not pay any heed.

outcome.final_order: Petitioner seeks issuance of writ in the nature of habeas corpus, for production of minor daughter, Vasupalli Manjula Satya Sri (aged 4 years).

use_for_drafting: drafting a writ petition for child custody
advising on Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act
